name: email_verify_link

metadata.description: Email verification message containing the fully resolved frontend verification link.
notes: `user` is a dict (user.to_dict('basic')) auto-injected by User.send_template_email if missing.
`token_url` is built server-side from tenant/project WEBAPP_BASE_URL and WEBAPP_AUTH_PATH settings, then may be shortened.

text_template:
Hello{% if user.display_name %} {{ user.display_name }}{% endif %},

Open this secure link to verify your email address:
{{ token_url }}

This link expires in 24 hours.

If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email.
html_template:
Verify your email address

Hello{% if user.display_name %} {{ user.display_name }}{% endif %},

Please verify your email address using the secure link below.

Verify email

If the button does not work, copy and paste this link into your browser:

{{ token_url }}

This link expires in 24 hours. If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email.

Sent by Django-MOJO
